title: Five Simple Rules to Learn English

paragraphs: Many English students spend years studying, but they still can’t speak with confidence.
It is no surprise that students are looking for better ways to study. Research shows that success often depends on following a few simple rules.
First, learn new words in stories instead of studying long word lists. Stories make new vocabulary easier to remember.
Second, practice the same words many times until they become natural.
Third, spend time speaking. Reading and listening are important, but speaking helps students use the language in real life.
The fourth rule is to choose materials that match your level.
Lessons that are too easy or too difficult can slow your progress.
Finally, students should have a clear learning plan and follow it regularly.
One learning game, LangoPlay, was created based on these rules. People can try it for free at www.langoplay.com.

paragraphs: Many people learn English for years, but they still can’t speak it well.
Many students want a better way to learn English. These five simple rules can help.
One, learn new words in a story. Don’t learn only single words. A story helps you remember new words.
Two, read and listen to the same words again and again. Stop only when you know them well.
Three, speak English as much as you can. Reading and listening are good, but you learn more when you speak.
Four, use lessons for your level. If the lessons are very easy or very difficult, you learn very little.
Finally, have a plan. Follow your plan every day.
